blurb: Guests arrive at dawn to watch the balloon inflate, then take a private approximately one hour flight over Heber Valley's lakes, fields, and mountain peaks. The experience ends with a champagne or sparkling cider toast. Flights are private, intimate, and designed for couples, with professional photos included.
extraNote: Reschedule or full refund if weather cancels flight · Payment or deposit fully refunded if rescheduling not possible due to weather · Heber City Airport · Spring through fall, most popular May through October
